en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a peaceful town square or park. In the foreground are garden beds bordered by low wire hoops, gravel paths, and iron benches under tall trees. On the right is a wooden building with a columned veranda. In the distance, around an open square, stand several 2–3‑storey classical-style buildings, one with a distinctive mansard or pavilion-like roof. The word "Hamina" is printed in the lower right corner.
